summary: JD.com filed a Form 6-K containing a Hong Kong Stock Exchange announcement that its board will meet on August 13, 2026 to approve interim financial results for the three and six months ended June 30, 2026. The filing also details the post-results conference call, dial-in access, and webcast. This is a routine earnings schedule notice, not a special-situation event such as a merger, tender offer, or strategic review. No transactions, stake changes, price terms, or corporate actions are disclosed. The filing merely informs shareholders of an upcoming board meeting and earnings call, with no actionable special-situation content.
